patthana13.22:1.1: dhammaṃ paṭicca na anidassana sappaṭigho dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā. anidassana sappaṭighaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca na sanidassana sappaṭigho dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā. anidassana sappaṭighaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca na anidassana appaṭigho dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā. anidassana sappaṭighaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca na sanidassana sappaṭigho ca na anidassana sappaṭigho ca dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā. anidassana sappaṭighaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca na anidassana sappaṭigho ca na anidassana appaṭigho ca dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā. anidassana sappaṭighaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca na sanidassana sappaṭigho ca na anidassana appaṭigho ca dhammā uppajjanti hetupaccayā. cha, anidassana appaṭighaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca
patthana13.22:2.1: na anidassana appaṭigho dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā. cha,
patthana13.22:3.1: na anidassana sappaṭiñca anidassana appaṭighañca dhammaṃ paṭicca na sanidassana sappaṭigho dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā. cha,
patthana13.22:4.1: hetuyā aṭṭhārasa, ārammaṇe tīṇi, avigate aṭṭhārasa, (sabbattha vitthāretabbaṃ.) (sahajātavārampi sampayuttavārampi vitthāretabbaṃ.)
patthana13.22:5.1: anidassana appaṭigho dhammo na anidassana appaṭighassa dhammassa hetupaccayena paccayo. anidassana appaṭigho dhammo na sanidasasna sappaṭighassa dhammassa hetupaccayena paccayo. anidassana appaṭigho dhammo na anidassana sappaṭighassa dhammassa hetupaccayena paccayo. anidassana appaṭigho dhammo na sanidassana sappaṭighassa ca na anidassana appaṭighassa ca dhammassa hetupaccayena paccayo. anidassana appaṭigho dhammo na anidassa sappaṭighassa ca na anidassana appaṭighassa ca dhammassa hetupaccayena paccayo. anidassana appaṭigho dhammo na sanidassana sappaṭighassa ca na anidassana appaṭighassa ca dhammassa hetupaccayena paccayo.
patthana13.22:6.1: cha, sanidassana sappaṭigho dhammo na sanidassana sappaṭighassa dhammassa ārammaṇapaccayena paccayo. tīṇi, …pe…
patthana13.22:7.1: hetuyā cha, ārammaṇe nava, (pañhāvāraṃ vitthāretabbaṃ.) anulomapaccanīya tikapaṭṭhānaṃ niṭṭhitaṃ.
